extras: Uses internal Obsidian APIs that may break on major updates.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that fixes a bug in the built-in local graph where notes connected through shared tags are not shown.
problem: When 'Show Tags' is enabled in the local graph, Obsidian stops traversal at tag nodes, preventing notes connected via shared tags from appearing.
summary: Fixes a bug in the local graph by allowing traversal through shared tags, making notes connected via shared tags visible.
